{"content": "import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

example (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64)
    (qs : List Req) :
    run p s ((now, to, amount) :: qs) =
      (match run p (step p s now to amount).2 qs with
       | (sf, vs) => (sf, (step p s now to amount).1 :: vs)) := rfl

example (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64)
    (qs : List Req) (v : Verdict) (s' : State)
    (h : step p s now to amount = (v, s')) :
    (run p s ((now, to, amount) :: qs)).2 = v :: (run p s' qs).2 := by
  have hh : run p s ((now, to, amount) :: qs) =
      (match run p (step p s now to amount).2 qs with
       | (sf, vs) => (sf, (step p s now to amount).1 :: vs)) := rfl
  rw [h] at hh
  cases e2 : run p s' qs with
  | mk sf vs =>
    rw [e2] at hh
    rw [hh]

end Solution
"}
